title: T-Mobile US, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-28
summary: T-Mobile US, Inc. filed Form 8-K on April 28, 2026, announcing Q1 2026 financial and operating results for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. Signed by CFO Peter Osvaldik.
